q: A function with f'(x) > 0 everywhere has a maximum.
why: Myth. It keeps rising forever, so on all real numbers there's no highest point.

q: Find the limit of ((2 + h)² − 4)/h as h → 0.
why: That's the derivative of x² at x = 2: 2 · 2 = 4. Or expand: (4h + h²)/h = 4 + h → 4.

q: Elasticity is −0.5. Raising the price will…
o: raise revenue, because demand is inelastic
why: A 1% price rise cuts quantity by only 0.5%, so price × quantity goes up.
